scope_statement: Purposive sample of high-impact/seminal AI paper figures plus official related repository illustrations. No objective 'best papers' ranking or representative population inference. Twenty official assets actually displayed; some are repository rearrangements or supplements, not the publication page itself. No hundreds-of-papers visual-review claim is warranted by this ledger.
retrieval_method: GitHub connector fetch_file with encoding=base64; nonempty image bytes displayed using image(). Captions and methods checked using primary arXiv PDFs/HTML. PDF screenshot web interface returned reference strings without image pixels; direct arXiv downloads returned403.

visual_reviews.design_observation: Repeated gull image makes predicted-to-target matching tangible.
visual_reviews.limitation: Mark matching as training-only; unmatched queries predict no-object.

visual_reviews.design_observation: Picture patches retain their identity through tokenization; detail lives in an inset.
visual_reviews.limitation: Many parallel arrows become clutter at column width.

visual_reviews.design_observation: Large encoder, small prompt/decoder blocks, multiple scissors masks convey amortization and ambiguity.
visual_reviews.limitation: Area suggests qualitative size, not a calibrated FLOPs ratio; text-prompt support must match the actual implementation being drawn.

visual_reviews.design_observation: Nested pixel, latent, and conditioning regions explain where computation occurs.
visual_reviews.limitation: Dense legend and tiny Q/K/V marks need enlargement or a separate inset.

visual_reviews.design_observation: Matched crops expose thin-structure quality alongside speed and training cost.
visual_reviews.limitation: One scene is not aggregate evidence; two proposed settings trade quality against speed.

visual_reviews.design_observation: Orange state streams and blue input-dependent selection reveal two interacting mechanisms.
visual_reviews.limitation: State replication and channel count are schematic; label dimensions if used quantitatively.

visual_reviews.design_observation: Gray locked blocks contrast with a blue trainable copy and zero-convolution links.
visual_reviews.limitation: Long bypasses can disappear after reduction; label additive links and training state explicitly.

visual_reviews.publication_relationship: Repository composite of hierarchy, shifted windows, blocks and stages
visual_reviews.design_observation: Spatial windows make cross-window communication concrete.
visual_reviews.limitation: Composite contains several abstraction levels; separate overview and mechanism when small.

visual_reviews.design_observation: Training pairing matrix and zero-shot label prompts share modality colors.
visual_reviews.limitation: Keep training separate from deployment; matrix cells are similarities, not measured task accuracies.

visual_reviews.publication_relationship: Repository sample montage; related to paper sample figures
visual_reviews.design_observation: Diverse image domains immediately communicate generative capability.
visual_reviews.limitation: A montage alone provides neither algorithm semantics nor comparative evidence; do not imply cherry-picked examples are a distributional test.

visual_reviews.design_observation: Bottleneck diagram, tiling computation, and time decomposition form a compact causal story.
visual_reviews.limitation: Hardware figures are version-specific; 7.6× concerns the reported attention benchmark. Never estimate exact component timings by eye.

visual_reviews.design_observation: The same two rays connect coordinate samples, network output, integration, and rendering loss.
visual_reviews.limitation: Density depends on position; view direction conditions color. A generic joint-output box can hide this distinction.

visual_reviews.design_observation: Matrix transposition visibly distinguishes token mixing from channel mixing.
visual_reviews.limitation: Colors encode tensor organization; do not reuse them for unrelated module classes in the same figure.

visual_reviews.publication_relationship: Earlier Fig. 2 variant; v2 PDF p. 8 adds Adapter(H)
visual_reviews.design_observation: Two aligned cost–accuracy plots expose efficiency across orders of magnitude.
visual_reviews.limitation: Repository raster and latest PDF differ. Use source table values, not old curve interpolation; include missing baselines when appropriate.

visual_reviews.design_observation: Small projection bridge connects visual tokens to the language token stream.
visual_reviews.limitation: The fan of token arrows becomes hairline clutter; compress it without suggesting bidirectional generation.

visual_reviews.design_observation: Frozen towers, central query bridge, staged labels, and one example state the proposal.
visual_reviews.limitation: Explain snowflakes in words; lengthy example text competes with the method.

visual_reviews.design_observation: Shared image/question and aligned response rows permit direct qualitative comparison.
visual_reviews.limitation: Long prose is slow to scan; quote only the diagnostic spans, preserving meaning and selection provenance.

visual_reviews.publication_relationship: Repository training benchmark; exact paper-figure match not established
visual_reviews.design_observation: Dataset/resolution small multiples keep GPU-count colors consistent and retain visible instability.
visual_reviews.limitation: Axis ranges differ; identify each panel's scale. Do not smooth away spikes or equate unequal hardware budgets.

visual_reviews.publication_relationship: Repository mathematical teaser; exact paper-figure match not established
visual_reviews.design_observation: A zoom inset connects local trajectory behavior with global sampling geometry.
visual_reviews.limitation: Unlabeled density color and technical axes are insufficient for a lay teaser; add a plain-language explanation.

visual_reviews.design_observation: Faded temporal copies and routed memory loops communicate streaming reuse.
visual_reviews.limitation: Caption explicitly notes an omitted image-embedding input to the memory encoder; restore it when the task demands architectural completeness.
